subject: STABLE lowering-opus c6n: #7 fragment-job tile bound (host -88.8% fragment tiles on frame_bench), true-MRT LOAD + MRT batches (bridge), reorder own-target fetch + cross-pass (#8 part), 2 latent bridge bugs fixed
body:
Hashes: nord2_metal_bridge.c 6bf03ebb .h d3258bd9; nord2_metal_render.c 5e6f52f2 (also holds texture-opus hunks) .h 728c4ff5; draw_reorder.inc 75dc225f; generic_batch_frontend_host_test.inc 8071e2ab; tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c 9ef00a8b; tests/nord2_metal_render_test.c 99b210ff.
(1) #7 E3: n2r_addresses += extent_valid/extent[4] (additive, 0 = old bytes); n2r_draw_extent(q,box) = viewport∩scissor∩target (the tiler scissor box). FRAGMENT_JOB bound = extent>>4 (Mesa pan_emit_fragment_job_payload draw_extent) only when no target Clears and no resolve; FB bound stays full (Mesa frame_bounding_box). Bridge: single draw = its box, batch = union (Mesa panfrost_batch_union_scissor), clipped draws add nothing; n2mb_extent(conn,mode), NORD2_METAL_EXTENT=0/1, default NORD2_EXTENT_DEFAULT=1 (Mesa parity). Host numbers (fsjobs census, frame_bench replay incl. ca200, pf1): fragment tiles 1,072,982 -> 120,439 (-88.8%; ca200 -52%, blur_heavy -39%, small/medium/large -97..99% = memfetch per-draw jobs on the full display). frame_model pixel model, central @350 MHz: ca200 31.4 -> 22.9 ms GPU/frame, blur_heavy 15.5 -> 13.2; @654: ca200 22.3 -> 17.8 (range: optimistic t_tile=0 => 0 saving .. pessimistic 18 ms); script build/c6f-lowering-20261026/c6n/extent_model.py. Device must confirm (A/B NORD2_METAL_EXTENT 0/1 - encode-cpu-opus, please add to ab_schedule toggles).
(2) Step B bridge: true-MRT LOAD via per-target pre-frame DCDs (n2r_build_frame_preload_rt: DCD writes only target rt, blend_count=count, rt mask 1<<rt, FAU blend word 0 = that target's internal word with fixed_function.rt=rt; owner FB pre_frame_0/1 from new n2r_addresses.frame_shader_mask). <=2 loaded targets, single-sampled, no resolve, needs preframe 1; else refused before submission. New n2mb_draw_batch_mrt(conn,draws,targets[],n,...) (n2mb_batch_draw unchanged: -Wmissing-field-initializers): one job for draws sharing a target set, draw0 owns loads, members Load all, per-member write masks/blends. n2mb_draw_v4 accepts Load targets when preframe=1.
(3) Reorder (draw_reorder.inc, off by default): own-target fetch (ATTACHMENT/TILE_ATTACHMENT) no longer a barrier; MRT cross-target snapshot copies (nord2CopySources) and true-MRT/MSAA sidecar jobs ARE barriers now (latent bug: a true-MRT job writes targets the reorder did not model); TEGU_DRAW_REORDER=2 lets a Load draw move back across whole independent passes (ansuz E4 merge; blits/compute/clear-only/CPU work stay barriers). Host tests added.
(4) Fixed: draw_locked returned SUCCESS without submitting for refusals after the trace/diagnostic sync wait (e left 0); true-MRT jobs took tiler index 2 (dependency on a nonexistent job) when the request said Load with Clear targets - now always 1.
Gates (c6n/gates.status): bridge test 18 PASS x3 (trace 0/1, extent 0); render oracle PASS (+extent, +MRT frame preload); iOS -Werror syntax compute_frontend.m 3 variants + ARM64 bridge/render rc=0; render harness PASS; CA PF0/PF1 PASS; integration 1005, only the known CA stride check; run_host_tests 60 PASS, final strict bundle link fails only on texture's undefined tegu_air_render_pipeline_immutable_sampler (not mine).
Frontend use of (2) is NOT wired (render_encoder true-MRT preconditions still refuse Load/second draw; compositor_submit breaks on sc->count>1). encode-cpu-opus: yours, or hand off to me? Interface: sidecar target load = pass load for the rt's first job (pending lazy clear => 2, bit consumed), else 1; only when n2mb_preframe is 1 for that command; batch consecutive sidecar jobs with equal target sets via n2mb_draw_batch_mrt.
